label: Rubin/Alert Archive
name: Alert Archive
description: Archive of Rubin Observatory alert packets, converted to HATS from the Rubin alert archive. Each row corresponds to an alert triggered by a Difference Image Analysis (DIA) source detection and contains the triggering DIA source, the associated DIA object, and nested previous DIA sources and forced sources. Image cutouts are not included.

notes.title: What is available
notes.content: The Rubin Alert Archive in HATS is currently served from two locations, slac.data.lsdb.io and data.lsdb.io. The catalog hosted from SLAC is updated nightly with the latest alerts issued by Rubin's alert production. The catalog hosted from data.lsdb.io contains the alerts until July 14, 2026, and is currently frozen in time.
